facts.macosBoundary: macOS-only sandbox-exec boundary denies every network operation, including loopback TCP and pathname Unix-domain sockets.
facts.linuxUnavailable: Linux unavailable: its current boundary does not block pathname Unix-domain sockets.
facts.windowsUnavailable: Windows unavailable: an AppContainer native launcher is not included.

limitations.sandboxDeprecation: sandbox-exec is deprecated; if it is unavailable or its boundary self-test fails, Laya is unavailable.
limitations.englishAccuracy: Accuracy in languages other than English is not established.
